primaryFindings.claim: Polar bears belong to Arctic sea-ice habitat across ice-covered seas of the Northern Hemisphere, so the key is uniquely correct.
Emperor penguins breed in colonies around the Antarctic continent, mostly on fast ice.
Weddell seals are circumpolar Antarctic coastal animals associated with fast ice and pup there.
Adélie penguins breed around the Antarctic coast and small rocky islands.
